dct_description_sm: Most of the views in this drawer were transferred to the Prints and Photographs Department of the Library of Congress. The front of the folder is retained in this collection as a record of the current location of the objects.

Most of the views in this drawer were transferred to the Prints and Photographs Department of the Library of Congress. The front of the folder is retained in this collection as a record of the current location of the objects. This record covers single maps of Philadelphia, showing various subjects, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
